declared_before: Written and committed before any fixture below was generated or evaluated. Development probes used other seeds (0-11) and other settings; the evaluation seed is 20261011.
evidence_type: SIMULATED AND RENDERED. Stand-in recordings come from the lumped circuit (and, for off-model cases, from added features it cannot produce or from an independent ODE of a different topology). No real machine, no laboratory recording. This evaluation does not establish real CPRI accuracy.

settings.cpri_lightning: CPRI profile (12 x 0.125 uF), 1425 kV Lightning, recommended by the existing optimizer with the test stock (30/465 ohm front, 520 ohm tail, one per stage).
settings.cpri_switching: CPRI profile, 1050 kV Switching; front and tail resistances solved continuously to 250/2500 us (fixture truth need not be constructible).
settings.workbook_lightning: Workbook profile (15 x 3 uF), 1425 kV Lightning; resistances solved continuously to 1.2/50 us.

families.no_change: Recording equals the prediction at the recorded settings (all three settings).
families.single_in_model: front x0.75, front x1.3, tail x0.7, tail x1.35, load-side capacitance +350 pF and -300 pF, inductance 35 uH (CPRI Lightning); front x0.8 and tail x1.25 (CPRI Switching, workbook Lightning).
families.combined_in_model: front x0.85 with tail x1.2; capacitance +300 pF with inductance 30 uH (CPRI Lightning).
families.ambiguous_amplitude: gain x0.94 (CPRI Lightning) with as-fired settings recorded, and charge x0.95 with as-fired settings not recorded.
families.off_model: (a) 4 MHz damped oscillation of 6% superimposed on the front and crest; (b) slow second tail component of 12% of crest; (c) both; (d) a precursor of 35% crest 0.1 us before the main rise.
families.topology_variant: 40% of the tail conductance at the load side (independent ODE). Reported descriptively; no gate, because an effective tail resistance can legitimately represent it.
families.noise_and_scale: noise 1.5% of crest with front x0.8; and gain x1.03 declared as a divider-scale uncertainty.
families.ringing_in_model: inductance 80 uH with front x0.25 (oscillatory but inside the lumped model).
families.clipping: Recording clipped at 92% of crest (flat top).
families.different_settings: Shot at 95% charge: (i) as-fired charge recorded, (ii) not recorded.
families.unit_mistake: Time column in ms labelled as us (x1000 error).

image_fixtures.source: The CPRI Lightning truths above (no change and front x0.8) rendered with matplotlib and digitized back through the API with anchors at the rendered axis positions (a careful user) and a seed point on the curve.
variants: second curve in the same colour
perspective photo JPEG q80 rectified from its four plot corners
dark oscilloscope style with per-division calibration
image_fixtures.manual_check_set: Four overlays (clean, photo, thick, same colour) are inspected by eye and recorded in manual_checks.json with notes.

recorded_per_case: fitted values and their errors against the truth
metric errors of digitized samples against the truth
whether the digitization spread contains the truth

gates.G1_no_change: No-change CSV fixtures: verdict 'No change needed' in every case.
gates.G2_single_identified: Single in-model CSV fixtures: the true explanation is the leading one or among 'Several explanations fit' in at least 80% of cases, and its fitted value is within 5% of the truth (20 pF / 2 uH absolute allowance).
gates.G3_no_confident_false_cause: Off-model CSV fixtures (a)-(d): never 'Possible cause' with a single hardware explanation.
gates.G4_amplitude_competition: Amplitude-only fixtures: never a single cause; at least two explanations retained.
gates.G5_image_round_trip: Clean, perspective-photo and oscilloscope images: crest within 1.5%, tail within 3%, front within 6% of the truth whenever the front is reported as resolved; the 5-95% digitization spread contains the truth for at least two thirds of reported metrics.
gates.G6_integrity: Clipping, same-colour, negative-polarity and unit-mistake fixtures: quantitative diagnosis disabled or every affected metric marked 'Requires review' / 'Insufficient capture' (no silent comparison).
gates.G7_no_extrapolation: Missing-falling-limb fixtures (CSV and image): tail never reported as a value.
gates.G8_settings_difference: Different-settings fixture with as-fired charge recorded: 'No change needed' against the as-fired prediction; without it: diagnosis marked limited and charge among the retained explanations.

decision: Results are reported whatever they are. A failed gate is reported as failed and explained; thresholds and fixtures are not changed after evaluation. Any code fix made after a failure is disclosed in results.json with the cases re-run.
not_established: Real CPRI accuracy, real photo digitization accuracy on laboratory screenshots, and real fault attribution remain unknown until real recordings with known causes are available.
